### What else matters?

Which app was playing behind an overlay? Did Android grant **Display over other apps**? Did any playback fail because of DRM/protected content? Did TALK work with the actual accessible microphone rather than Google Assistant's reserved remote mic?

### Privacy reminder

Upload only redacted images. Do not post home addresses, tokens, private camera video, credentials, pairing IDs, or third-party personal details. Community reports are **not** an official compatibility guarantee.
